# Alexandre Masy

> Experience Strategy & Human+AI Design Leader. Navigating complexity at the intersection of CX, org design & AI.

Alexandre Masy is an experience designer and strategist (15+ years) who mixes strategy and technology to create beautiful experiences. He leads experience strategy in high-complexity environments — at the intersection of Human + AI — turning ambiguous business challenges into coherent journeys, operating models, and decisions at scale. From service orchestration to design leadership, he bridges strategy and craft.

His current mission is with BNP Paribas Fortis as Business Designer.

## Experience

### BNP Paribas Fortis — Business Designer (2021–present)
Role: Business Designer, Team Lead Concept & UX, Concept Designer
Context: In-house / Large financial institution

Alexandre has been embedded at BNP Paribas Fortis for 4+ years across three successive roles, working at the intersection of experience strategy, service design, and Human + AI transformation in one of Belgium's most complex financial environments.

Key achievements:
- Led the future experience vision for insurance, aligning 3 partner companies at C-level in under 3 months, grounded in multi-market research and strategic benchmarks (Deloitte, McKinsey). Delivered guiding principles, illustrated scenarios, and a shared roadmap.
- Designed the ecosystem architecture for a hybrid Human + AI experience for the next generation of professional lending, following a 6-month facilitation program with 60+ stakeholders across segments.
- Led a 6-person Concept & UX team across the Lending & Protect domain, building shared frameworks, design maturity, and cross-squad alignment that reduced decision latency at scale.
- Designed and validated end-to-end experience concepts across customers, advisors, and back-office teams, translating complex product logic and regulatory constraints into coherent journeys.

### Movify — Design Lead (2021–present)
Role: Design Lead (part-time)
Context: Design & Technology Consulting

Part-time design leadership role embedded in Movify's consulting practice. Alexandre mentors consultants on experience strategy, facilitation, and AI-assisted design, sharing field-tested methods from complex regulated environments.

Key achievements:
- Active speaker in the broader design community through conferences, podcasts, and articles on design leadership and AI-assisted design in regulated industries.
- Builds and animates community across Movify's design lead network.

## Selected Work

### Sayl — Hospitality Digitalisation Platform (2018–2021)
Role: Product Design, Brand Design, Lead Frontend Architect
Duration: 42 months (June 2018 – November 2021)
Context: Startup / Scale-up

Sayl is a best-in-class omnichannel platform that helps hospitality businesses digitalize their operations. Alexandre was the sole designer in a small tech team, responsible for the full product design across the platform: an online and offline shopping experience, a kitchen display system, and a merchant management web application.

Key achievements:
- Designed 50+ user flows, 20 fully tested prototypes, 200+ views across 5 languages
- Built a design system with 100+ components and 500+ icons
- Platform powers 100+ restaurants across Europe and processes 10,000+ orders weekly
- Designed and implemented the full Sayl brand identity (logo, brand guide, design system)

### International Duty Free — Lagardère Travel Retail Belgium (2019)
Role: UX Design, Visual Design, Web Design
Duration: 8 months (February 2019 – October 2019)
Context: Consultant

Designed a premium e-commerce experience for the historical duty-free leader in Belgium, present at Brussels Zaventem airport, Brussels-South Charleroi airport, and Brussels South train station. The challenge was to blend a luxury brand aesthetic with the specific constraints of duty-free e-commerce (double pricing, purchase flows tied to flight schedules).

Key achievements:
- Designed a consistent shopping experience across web, mobile, and kiosk
- The e-shop was approved by Dior as one of few authorised resellers online

### La Cité des Métiers — Brussels (2019)
Role: UX Design, Visual Design, Web Design, Design Methodology Coach
Duration: 8 months (February 2019 – October 2019)
Context: External Consultant at Actiris

Created the digital home for La Cité des Métiers, a professional guidance center initiated by Actiris in Brussels, open to everyone regardless of age, status, or qualification level. Alexandre worked as an external consultant embedded within the Actiris team.

Key achievements:
- Designed online and in-situ digital experience (including kiosks)
- Organised workshops to onboard the internal team on design methodology (discover, explore, test, listen)
- Coached the Actiris design and development team to ensure long-term autonomy on the project
